units.source_text: 看到的两颗大黑痣是在右脸颊上。

en.t: The two large black moles that could be seen were on the right cheek.
The eyebrow on the right side looked very long.

units.source_text: 眉梢在眼睑上方画出一道弓形，耷拉在合上的眼睑线上。

en.t: The end of the eyebrow traced an arc above the eyelid and drooped over the line of the closed lid.

units.source_text: 为什么会照得这么长呢？

en.t: Why had it come out looking so long in the photograph?

units.source_text: 这根长眉和两颗大黑痣，似乎给那张遗容增添了仁爱的色彩。

en.t: That long eyebrow and the two large black moles seemed to add a touch of benevolence to the face of the deceased.
